title: Chatticus: what a Story agent needs
description: Gaps found 2026-11-02. A channel belongs to one user but a Story conversation is shared by editors. No general sub-agent tool found in the Chatticus tree (the task tool is household tasks). Bots provision a computer, heavy for one bot per Story; check the computerless profile. Papyrus pins an unmerged Chatticus commit, 10 ahead and 13 behind main.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Corrected 2026-11-02 after reading Chatticus develop. Shared channels and org-owned bots ARE built (epic chatticus-818d20): channels carry participants. A text-only turn does not start a computer. The real gaps: (1) Chatticus PR 650 must land; it waits on Ryan's chat UI review and Papyrus depends on its unmerged commit. (2) The embedded chat gives each editor a private conversation, so shared channels do not reach Papyrus. (3) No sub-agent tool; pi-durable supports task-owned children, and cost accounting chatticus-24308d should land with it. (4) One channel per Story with room for more. (5) A way for the host to give a bot its own tools: not checked yet. (6) Bot memory across channels is an open question in docs/ORGANIZATIONS.md. Ryan: do not work around these in Papyrus.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Correction to the earlier correction: Chatticus channels store participants, but createChannel takes one human and nothing adds another, so several people cannot yet share a channel. Gaps are now tracked in chatticus-4b2417 (6 tasks).

comments.author: home
comments.text: Stale note: the Papyrus pin db862e38 is now on Chatticus develop, since PR 650 merged.
